thread.title: Apple shares hit new all-time intraday and closing highs

author: MacDailyNews
title: Apple shares hit new all-time intraday and closing highs
text:
Apple shares hit new all-time intraday and closing highs Thursday, May 10, 2018 · 4:21 pm · No Comments In Nasdaq trading today, shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) rose $2.68, or 1.43%, to hit a new all-time closing high of $190.04. Apple’s previous all-time closing high was $187.36 set on May 8, 2018.
AAPL’s all-time intraday high stands at $190.37, also set today.
Apple’s 52-week low stands at $142.20.
Apple, the world’s most valuable company, currently has a market value of $934.073 billion.
